title: Questions 191-195 refer to the following form, e-mail, and memo.
passage_1:
Product Replacement Request

Customer Name: Harriet Voss

My Lumavue pocket projector arrived on 5 September. At first, it worked exactly as described, with the various brightness settings and screen-fit options. But after ten days, it began switching itself off a few seconds after I turned it on. This happened no matter how long I had charged it. I would like a replacement for the faulty unit to be sent to the address held in my member profile. I have been pleased with Lumavue’s other products in the past, so I hope this is simply a one-time problem.

To:Rosa Iyer <r.iyer@lumavue.com>
From:Owen Castellanos <o.castellanos@precisionplantworks.com>
Date:16 September
Subject:Re: Inquiry

Dear Ms. Iyer,

Thank you for getting in touch. We have reviewed your inquiry form and have found that our next free slot is 10 October. If you need express service, special arrangements can be made. Please be aware that an extra fee will apply. Given the size of your plant, our audit team would need four full days to carry out a complete review of the facilities. Their improvement recommendations are normally issued three working days after the last day of the audit. Please tell me how you would like to proceed, and our legal department will prepare a contract.

Respectfully,
Owen Castellanos
Director of Audits
Precision Plantworks

MEMO

To: Production Staff
From: Dora Lindqvist, Plant Manager
Date: 19 September
Subject: Site Audit
Attachment: Customer Complaint

Please read the complaint from Ms. Voss. It is the ninth we have had this month related to that problem. Because of worries that faulty units are damaging our reputation, the operations team has hired an outside audit firm. Representatives of Precision Plantworks will review the site from 2 October. I ask for your full cooperation with the auditors. I will speak to individual line supervisors about sharing our quality control procedures with them.
